readings.title: A Request for Possession
readings.text: [Numbers 32:1] And the children of Re’uḇen and the children of Gaḏ had much livestock, a very great amount. And they saw <dn>את</dn> the land of Ya’zer and <dn>את</dn> the land of Gil’aḏ, and see, the place was a place for livestock. [2] And the children of Gaḏ and the children of Re’uḇen came and spoke to Mosheh, and to El’azar the priest, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying, [3] “Ataroth, and Diḇon, and Ya’zer, and Nimrah, and Ḥeshbon, and El’aleh, and Seḇam, and Neḇo, and Be’on, [4] the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> smote before the congregation of Yisra’ĕl, is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock.” [5] And they said, “If we have found favour in your eyes, let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us pass over <dn>את</dn> the Yardĕn.” [6] And Mosheh said to the children of Gaḏ and to the children of Re’uḇen, “Are your brothers to go to the battle while you sit here? [7] “And why do you discourage <dn>את</dn> the heart of the children of Yisra’ĕl from passing over into the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given them? [8] “This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Qaḏĕsh Barnĕa to see <dn>את</dn> the land. [9] “For when they went up to the wadi Eshkol and saw <dn>את</dn> the land, they discouraged <dn>את</dn> the heart of the children of Yisra’ĕl, so that they did not go into the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had given them. [10] “And the displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> burned on that day, and <dn>He</dn> swore, saying, [11] <dq>‘Not one of the men who came up from Mitsrayim, from twenty years old and upward, shall see <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>I</dn> swore to Aḇraham, Yitsḥaq, and Ya’aqoḇ, because they did not follow <dn>Me</dn> completely,</dq> [12] <dq>except Kaleḇ son of Yephunneh, the Qenizite, and Yehoshua son of Nun, for they have followed <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> completely.’</dq> [13] “So the displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> burned against Yisra’ĕl, and <dn>He</dn> made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation that had done <dn>את</dn> evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was consumed. [14] “And see, you have risen in your fathers’ place, a brood of men, sinners, to increase still more the burning displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> against Yisra’ĕl. [15] “For if you turn away from following <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>He</dn> shall once again leave them in the wilderness, and you shall destroy all these people.”

readings.title: The Pledge of the Vanguard
readings.text: [Numbers 32:16] And they came near to him and said, “Let us build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones, [17] but let us ourselves be armed, hastening before the children of Yisra’ĕl until we have brought them to their place. And our little ones shall dwell in the walled cities because of the inhabitants of the land. [18] “We shall not return to our houses until every one of the children of Yisra’ĕl has received his inheritance. [19] “For we shall not inherit with them on the other side of the Yardĕn and beyond, because our inheritance has fallen to us on this eastern side of the Yardĕn.” [20] And Mosheh said to them, “If you do <dn>את</dn> this: if you arm yourselves before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for battle, [21] and all your armed ones pass over <dn>את</dn> the Yardĕn before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> until <dn>He</dn> has driven out <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> enemies from before <dn>Him</dn>, [22] and the land is subdued before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and before Yisra’ĕl. And this land shall be your possession before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [23] “But if you do not do so, then see, you shall sin against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and know that your sin is going to find you out. [24] “Build cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep, and do what you have promised.” [25] And the children of Gaḏ and the children of Re’uḇen spoke to Mosheh, saying, “Your servants do as my master commands. [26] “Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock are there in the cities of Gil’aḏ, [27] but your servants pass over, every armed one of the army, before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to battle, as my master says.” [28] And Mosheh gave command concerning them to <dn>את</dn> El’azar the priest, to <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua son of Nun, and to <dn>את</dn> the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Yisra’ĕl. [29] And Mosheh said to them, “If the children of Gaḏ and the children of Re’uḇen pass over <dn>את</dn> the Yardĕn with you, every man armed for battle before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them <dn>את</dn> the land of Gil’aḏ as a possession. [30] “But if they do not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Kena’an.” [31] And the children of Gaḏ and the children of Re’uḇen answered, saying, “As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has said to your servants, so we do. [32] “We ourselves pass over armed before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> into the land of Kena’an, but the possession of our inheritance is with us beyond the Yardĕn.”

readings.title: Possession Beyond the Yardĕn
readings.text: [Numbers 32:33] So Mosheh gave to them, to the children of Gaḏ and to the children of Re’uḇen, and to half the tribe of Menashshĕh son of Yoseph, <dn>את</dn> the reign of Siḥon sovereign of the Amorites and <dn>את</dn> the reign of Og̱ sovereign of Bashan, the land with its cities within the borders, the cities of the surrounding land. [34] And the children of Gaḏ built <dn>את</dn> Diḇon, and <dn>את</dn> Ataroth, and <dn>את</dn> Aro’ĕr, [35] and <dn>את</dn> Atroth-Shophan, and <dn>את</dn> Ya’zer, and Yog̱behah, [36] and <dn>את</dn> Bĕth Nimrah, and <dn>את</dn> Bĕth Haran, walled cities, and folds for sheep. [37] And the children of Re’uḇen built <dn>את</dn> Ḥeshbon, and <dn>את</dn> El’aleh, and <dn>את</dn> Qiryathayim, [38] and <dn>את</dn> Neḇo, and <dn>את</dn> Ba’al Me’on – the names being changed – and <dn>את</dn> Shiḇmah. And they gave names to the cities which they built. [39] And the children of Maḵir son of Menashshĕh went to Gil’aḏ and took it, and drove out <dn>את</dn> the Amorites who were in it. [40] And Mosheh gave <dn>את</dn> Gil’aḏ to Maḵir son of Menashshĕh, and he dwelt in it. [41] And Ya’ir son of Menashshĕh went and took <dn>את</dn> its small towns, and called them Ḥawwoth Ya’ir. [42] And Noḇah went and took <dn>את</dn> Qenath and its villages, and called it Noḇah, after his own name.

readings.title: Stages of the Journey
readings.text: [Numbers 33:1] These are the departures of the children of Yisra’ĕl, who went out of the land of Mitsrayim by their divisions under the hand of Mosheh and Aharon. [2] And Mosheh wrote down <dn>את</dn> the starting points of their departures at the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And these are their departures according to their starting points: [3] And they departed from Ra’meses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the morrow after the Pesaḥ the children of Yisra’ĕl went out with a high hand before the eyes of all the Mitsrites, [4] while the Mitsrites were burying <dn>את</dn> all their first-born, whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had smitten among them. Also on their mighty ones <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had executed judgments. [5] Then the children of Yisra’ĕl departed from Ra’meses and camped in Sukkoth. [6] And they departed from Sukkoth and camped in Ĕtham, which is on the edge of the wilderness. [7] And they departed from Ĕtham and turned back to Pi Haḥiroth, which is east of Ba’al Tsephon. And they camped before Mig̱dol. [8] And they departed from before Haḥiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, went three days’ journey in the Wilderness of Ĕtham, and camped in Marah. [9] And they departed from Marah and came to Ĕlim. And at Ĕlim were twelve fountains of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there. [10] And they departed from Ĕlim and camped by the Sea of Reeds. [11] And they departed from the Sea of Reeds and camped in the Wilderness of Sin. [12] And they departed from the Wilderness of Sin and camped in Dophaqah. [13] And they departed from Dophaqah and camped in Alush. [14] And they departed from Alush and camped at Rephiḏim, and there was no water for the people to drink. [15] And they departed from Rephiḏim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai. [16] And they departed from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Qiḇroth Hatta’awah. [17] And they departed from Qiḇroth Hatta’awah and camped at Ḥatsĕroth. [18] And they departed from Ḥatsĕroth and camped in Rithmah. [19] And they departed from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perets. [20] And they departed from Rimmon Perets and camped in Liḇnah. [21] And they departed from Liḇnah and camped at Rissah. [22] And they departed from Rissah and camped in Qehĕlathah. [23] And they departed from Qehĕlathah and camped at Mount Shapher. [24] And they departed from Mount Shapher and camped in Ḥaraḏah. [25] And they departed from H_araḏah and camped in Maqhĕloth. [26] And they departed from Maqhĕloth and camped at Taḥath. [27] And they departed from Taḥath and camped in Teraḥ. [28] And they departed from Teraḥ and camped in Mithqah. [29] And they departed from Mithqah and camped in Ḥashmonah. [30] And they departed from Ḥashmonah and camped at Mosĕroth. [31] And they departed from Mosĕroth and camped in Benĕ Ya’aqan. [32] And they departed from Benĕ Ya’aqan and camped at Ḥor Haggiḏgaḏ. [33] And they departed from Ḥor Haggiḏgaḏ and camped in Yotḇathah. [34] And they departed from Yotḇathah and camped in Aḇronah. [35] And they departed from Aḇronah and camped at Etsyon Geḇer. [36] And they departed from Etsyon Geḇer and camped in the Wilderness of Tsin, which is Qaḏĕsh. [37] And they departed from Qaḏĕsh and camped at Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Eḏom. [38] And Aharon the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and died there in the fortieth year after the children of Yisra’ĕl had come out of the land of Mitsrayim, on the first day of the fifth month. [39] And Aharon was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor. [40] And the Kena’anite, the sovereign of Araḏ, who dwelt in the south in the land of Kena’an, heard of <dn>את</dn> the coming of the children of Yisra’ĕl. [41] And they departed from Mount Hor and camped in Tsalmonah. [42] And they departed from Tsalmonah and camped in Punon. [43] And they departed from Punon and camped in Oḇoth. [44] And they departed from Oḇoth and camped at Iyĕ Ha-Aḇarim, on the border of Mo’aḇ. [45] And they departed from Iyim and camped in Diḇon Gaḏ. [46] And they departed from Diḇon Gaḏ and camped in Almon Diḇlathayimah. [47] And they departed from Almon Diḇlathayimah and camped in the mountains of Aḇarim, before Neḇo. [48] And they departed from the mountains of Aḇarim and camped in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo. [49] And they camped by the Yardĕn, from Bĕth Yeshimoth as far as Aḇĕl Shittim in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ.

readings.title: Drive Out All the Inhabitants
readings.text: [Numbers 33:50] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo, saying, [51] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and say to them, ‘When you have passed over <dn>את</dn> the Yardĕn into the land of Kena’an,</dq> [52] <dq>‘then you shall drive out <dn>את</dn> all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and shall destroy <dn>את</dn> all their engraved stones, and shall destroy <dn>את</dn> all their moulded images, and lay waste <dn>את</dn> all their high places,</dq> [53] <dq>‘and you shall possess <dn>את</dn> the land and dwell in it, for <dn>I</dn> have given you <dn>את</dn> the land to possess it.</dq> [54] <dq>‘And you shall inherit <dn>את</dn> the land by lot according to your clans. To the larger you give <dn>את</dn> a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you give <dn>את</dn> a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any one, that is his. Inherit according to the tribes of your fathers. [55] ‘But if you do not drive out <dn>את</dn> the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it shall be that <dn>את</dn> those whom you let remain shall be pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall trouble you in the land where you dwell.</dq> [56] <dq>‘And it shall be that <dn>I</dn> do to you as <dn>I</dn> thought to do to them.’ ”</dq>
